missions.title: Lobby Shift Cipher
missions.briefing: Decode a rotating concierge schedule to identify the two-minute blind spot in the lobby sweep.
missions.objective: Find the safe infiltration window and submit the matching action sequence.

tasks.prompt: Given shifts A-B-C rotated every 4 minutes with B delayed by 2 minutes, which minute marks the only overlap where camera and guard are both absent?
Validate that the chosen entry action uses exactly one movement and one hack action.

missions.title: Vault Ledger Reconcile
missions.briefing: A corrupted transaction ledger hides the vault unlock checksum.
missions.objective: Recover the checksum and trigger a clean unlock.

tasks.prompt: Ledger rows are missing one value each; compute the only checksum divisible by both 7 and 9 from candidate totals 252, 261, 279.
Verify the final checksum submission is numeric and within 3-digit bounds.

missions.title: Breakroom Gossip Chain
missions.briefing: Three staff rumors conflict; only one identifies the active supervisor badge color.
missions.objective: Infer the true rumor and impersonate the correct role.

tasks.prompt: If Riley lies on Tuesdays, Noor always tells the truth, and the badge is not red, determine the badge color from statements: Riley=Blue, Noor=Green, Dex=Blue.
Confirm social action can only target one NPC per turn.

missions.title: Courtyard Laser Angles
missions.briefing: Two rotating lasers create alternating safe arcs in the courtyard.
missions.objective: Choose the safe path using angle arithmetic before the next sweep.

tasks.prompt: Laser A sweeps 45° every turn and Laser B sweeps 30° opposite direction. At turn 3, which arc (0°-30°, 30°-60°, 60°-90°) is clear?
Validate extraction is disallowed before objective progress reaches 100%.

missions.title: Dock Camera Grid
missions.briefing: A still image from dock CCTV shows crate markings and shadow directions that reveal which lane is unguarded.
missions.objective: Interpret the image clues and pick the unguarded lane.

tasks.prompt: Inspect the dock image and identify the only lane where crate shadows indicate no active floodlight.
Map lane identifiers A-D to numeric lanes 1-4 and return the final lane number.
Ensure chosen lane is not currently flagged by a detected guard patrol.

missions.title: Server Rack Labels
missions.briefing: An image of mislabeled rack LEDs contains the true failover route.
missions.objective: Read indicator colors and select the correct rack pair.

tasks.prompt: From the rack photo, identify which two racks show amber-over-green LED stacks in the same column.
Translate rack IDs R2 and R5 to switch path notation using mapping R1=A, R2=B...

missions.title: Elevator Priority Queue
missions.briefing: A maintenance queue can be manipulated to reserve an elevator car.
missions.objective: Reorder requests legally to isolate one private ride.

tasks.prompt: Given priority values [VIP=9, Freight=4, Service=6] and one allowed swap, what order yields VIP first and Service second?
Check that only adjacent queue swaps are legal this mission.

missions.title: Art Wing Forgery
missions.briefing: An exhibit image includes subtle frame defects that identify the forged painting.
missions.objective: Use visual discrepancies to target the forged frame and extract the hidden key.

tasks.prompt: Compare the four gallery frames and identify the forgery by asymmetrical corner joint and incorrect reflection.
Convert frame letter C to extraction latch code where A=17 and each next letter adds 4.
Validate sabotage cannot be used after extraction has started.

missions.title: Rooftop Relay Drift
missions.briefing: A wind-shift table determines relay antenna drift and blind transmission windows.
missions.objective: Send one clean burst through the blind window.

tasks.prompt: If drift increments are +2, -1, +3 over three turns starting at channel 5, which channel is aligned at turn 3?
Confirm only one transmission attempt is allowed per turn.

missions.title: Loading Bay Pallets
missions.briefing: A pallet stack image and RFID notes disagree; only visual evidence reveals the decoy pallet.
missions.objective: Identify and tag the decoy pallet before guards scan inventory.

tasks.prompt: Inspect pallet labels and tape patterns to find the decoy with mirrored hazard stripe.
Using the mapping A=11, B=13, C=17, D=19, return the numeric tag for the decoy pallet.

missions.title: Subnet Smokescreen
missions.briefing: False subnet alarms must be filtered to reveal the true security pivot.
missions.objective: Select the real pivot subnet and push a spoof route.

tasks.prompt: From alerts 10.4.1.0/24, 10.4.2.0/24, 10.4.3.0/24 where only odd subnet has failed auth and packet loss >5%, pick the pivot.
Validate spoof route can only be applied after a successful scout or hack outcome.

missions.title: Final Clean Extract
missions.briefing: Combine social, network, and physical clues from prior missions for a no-lockdown extraction.
missions.objective: Complete objective and extract with alarm under threshold.

tasks.prompt: Choose the optimal 3-action chain from [Scout, Hack, Social, Sabotage, Extract] that maximizes objective progress while keeping alarm gain <= 2.
Verify extraction only succeeds if objective progress is complete and integrity is above zero.
